newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: Italy's STET to take 25 pct of Mobilkom.
newsitem.headline: Italy's STET to take 25 pct of Mobilkom.

text.p: Italy's state-controlled telecommunications firm, STET Group, plans to acquire a 25 percent stake of the capital of Mobilkom Austria, the companies said in a joint statement on Wednesday.
Mobilkom is the mobile telecommunications subsidiary of the national Austrian postal and telecommunications company Post und Telekom Austria AG (PTA).

The statement was released in Zurich because Union Bank of Switzerland was an advisor in the deal. A spokeswoman for PTA in Vienna confirmed the deal, which is subject to approval by the European Union Commission.
PTA will hold a news briefing on the planned transaction Wednesday morning in Vienna.
